name: diagnose_topic
description: Diagnose topic health: partitions/ISR, config, size/skew, writes, consumer lag/stuck, transactions, connectors, ACLs

intervalSeconds.description: Wait between two offset samples in seconds (default 3, 1-10; may be shortened to fit the time limit)

name: diagnose_consumer_group
description: Diagnose a consumer group: state/type, members and assignment, lag and trend, stuck partitions, missing topics, coordinator, ACLs

intervalSeconds.description: Wait between two offset samples in seconds (default 5, 1-10; may be shortened to fit the time limit)

name: diagnose_connector
description: Diagnose a connector: connector/task state and error summaries, config/plugin/converters, topics, sink lag, source writes, workers

intervalSeconds.description: Wait between two offset samples in seconds (default 5, 1-10; may be shortened to fit the time limit)

name: diagnose_cluster
description: Diagnose the cluster: mode/version, controller/quorum, brokers, URP/offline/min ISR, disks, balance, config drift, lag, connectors

name: diagnose_access
description: Check whether a principal is authorized for an intent (produce/consume/transactional-produce/admin-topic); suggests missing ACLs for acls_create

principal.description: Principal (e.g. User:alice; a bare name gets the User: prefix)

group.description: Consumer group (required for consume; for offset commits with transactional-produce)

host.description: Client IP (default *: only ACLs with host * match)

name: diagnose_connectivity
description: Diagnose connectivity step by step with timings: DNS, TCP, security/Kerberos, Kafka with a new client, advertised addresses, Connect/SR
